exposure: Mode of birth (vaginal delivery or cesarean section)
cohort: The study analyzed 101 peripheral blood samples from Rh-negative and Rh-positive pregnant women with a mean age of 24 years, taken after vaginal delivery or cesarean section.
finding: The study found that 53% of pregnant women had fetal red blood cell levels <2.0 mL, 31% had levels between 2.0-3.9 mL, 16% between 4.0-15.0 mL, and 1% had levels >15.0 mL.
cross-section timing: After vaginal delivery or cesarean section
